tab.title: Conveyance documents
tab.subtitle: What is in place, what is missing and what expires — from files already uploaded
tab.openCaseHint: The checklist fills itself from the documents of the property, building, project and contacts. Nothing needs to be uploaded again.
tab.loadError: The documents could not be loaded.
tab.conflict: Someone else changed the case in the meantime. The view was refreshed — please try again.
tab.catalogUnverified: The checklist is a draft (version {version}) and has not yet been verified by a notary.

summary.awaitingReview: {count, plural, one {# awaiting review} other {# awaiting review}}
summary.expiring: {count, plural, one {# expiring soon} other {# expiring soon}}
summary.questions: {count, plural, one {# question completes the checklist} other {# questions complete the checklist}}

signing.label: Planned signing
signing.hint: With a signing date, every certificate is checked for validity on that day.

cancel.title: Cancel conveyance case
cancel.description: The case will close without a completion binder. The property files are not touched.

sectionHints.property: Visible to all legal professionals and the buyer
sectionHints.seller: Personal — seller's lawyer and notary only
sectionHints.buyer: Personal — buyer's lawyer and notary only

row.invalidOnSigning: Will not be valid on the signing day
row.validityUnverified: Limited validity — duration not yet verified
row.actDay: Issued on the day of the deed
row.notApplicableByFact: Does not apply to this conveyance
row.offlineHint: Cannot be uploaded to the platform yet — confirm you received it.
row.uploadHint: Uploaded in the “Documents” tab of the {level}

dialogs.acceptDescription: Acceptance is bound to this version of the file; if a new version is uploaded, the document will ask for review again.
dialogs.issuedOnHint: Validity is calculated from this date.
dialogs.notApplicableDescription: The reason will be visible to everyone working on the case.

facts.title: Questions about the conveyance
facts.hint: The answers decide which documents are needed. Anything known from the data is not asked.

is_new_build.question: Is it a newly built property sold by the developer?

seller_is_legal_entity.question: Is the seller a legal entity (company)?

has_antiparochi.question: Was the property built under a land-for-flats (antiparochi) agreement?

is_unit_in_multi_owner_building.question: Is the property part of a building with several owners (horizontal ownership)?

has_appurtenances.question: Are a parking space or storage room sold with it?

existing_building_with_manager.question: Is there a building manager with shared expenses?

has_unauthorized_works.question: Are there unauthorized works or legalisations requiring an engineer's certificate?

seller_by_proxy.question: Will the seller be represented by power of attorney?

buyer_has_mortgage.question: Is the buyer financing with a mortgage?

first_home_exemption.question: Is the buyer claiming the first-home exemption?

special_zone.question: Is it in a forest, border or other special zone?

cadastral_extract.label: Cadastre: KAEK, registration certificate, plan extract

encumbrance_certificate.label: Certificate of encumbrances, seizures and claims

horizontal_property_deed.label: Horizontal ownership deed, share table and building regulation

building_identity.label: Electronic Building Identity and completeness certificate

engineer_legality_certificate.label: Engineer's certificate (art. 83 L.4495/2017) / legalisation of unauthorized works

building_manager_certificate.label: Building manager's certificate of no shared-expense debt

seller_corporate_documents.label: Articles of association, GEMI certificate and company representation

buyer_payment_proofs.label: Proof of bank payment of price and deposit

vat_or_suspension.label: New-build VAT or VAT suspension declaration

final_contract.title: Final Sale Contract
final_contract.description: Signed before a notary. Transfers ownership of the property.

preliminary_contract.title: Preliminary Sale Contract
preliminary_contract.description: Binding agreement before the final contract. Usually accompanied by a deposit.

bank_loan.title: Mortgage Application
bank_loan.description: Application to a bank for a mortgage. The bank requires a property valuation.

property_transfer.title: Property Transfer (after payoff)
property_transfer.description: Final transfer after full payment. Registered with the cadastre.

section.title: Professionals and access
section.hint: A professional sees only the documents of their role, and only after pressing “I take it on”. Never draft drawings, never prices.

appointment.not-appointed: Not appointed — appoint them in the “Legal” tab
appointment.no-email: The contact has no email — add one to grant access
appointment.needs-invitation: No account — send an email invitation
appointment.account: Has an account on the platform

consent.title: Consent of the buyer's side
consent.description: This role also sees the buyer's documents. State what the buyer's agreement is based on — it is recorded with your name and the time.

endConfirm.description: It takes effect immediately and the professional is notified. The access history stays on record.

delivery.accepted: The invitation was sent to the professional.
delivery.unaddressable: The invitation was created, but no email was sent: the app's public address is missing.
delivery.failed: The invitation was created, but the email did not go out — press “Resend”.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel the invitation?
cancelConfirm.description: The link in the email stops working immediately. You can send a new invitation at any time.

invite.title: Invitation to a conveyance case
invite.intro: {host} invites you to the conveyance case for the property {property}.
invite.find: {applicable} documents for your role — {complete} ready, {missing} pending
invite.scope: Accepting gives access to this case only — not to the inviting office.
invite.identityDeclared: The office details are as the office declared them.
invite.signIn: Sign in or sign up to answer
invite.signInHint: Use the email address the invitation was sent to. Signing up takes about 2 minutes.
invite.credentialHint: Your number is shown to the parties of the case as “declared”.
invite.numberRequired: Enter your registry number to take on the case.
invite.acceptedBody: The case is now in “My cases”.
invite.declinedBody: The person who invited you has been told. Nothing else is needed.
invite.unavailable: The invitation could not be checked right now. Please try again shortly.

refusals.link-invalid: This link does not match an invitation.
refusals.link-foreign: This link does not match an invitation.
refusals.invitation-unknown: This link does not match an invitation.
refusals.expired: The invitation has expired — ask the sender for a new one.
refusals.already-used: The invitation has already been answered.
refusals.revoked: The invitation was cancelled or replaced by a newer one — check your latest email.
refusals.wrong-recipient: The invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with that one or ask for a new invitation.
refusals.slot-occupied: The position was filled in the meantime by another professional.
refusals.role-conflict: You already have another role in this case.
refusals.case-closed: The case has closed — the invitation no longer applies.

rejections.case-closed: The case is closed — it does not accept new professionals.
rejections.no-project: The property does not belong to a project — access is granted within a project.
rejections.not-appointed: No professional has been appointed to this role.
rejections.no-email: The professional's contact has no email.
rejections.consent-basis-required: State the basis of the buyer's consent.
rejections.slot-occupied: This role already has another professional — revoke their access first.
rejections.role-conflict: This person already has another role in this case.
rejections.unreadable: The access history of this role cannot be read — please contact support.
rejections.generic: The action did not complete. Please try again.

myCases.title: My cases
myCases.subtitle: Conveyance cases where you were appointed as lawyer or notary.
myCases.empty: No case has been offered to you yet.
myCases.loadError: Your cases could not be loaded. Please try again.

respondRejections.unknown: Your answer could not be sent. Please try again.
respondRejections.offer-expired: The offer has expired — ask whoever appointed you for a new one.
respondRejections.not-allowed: The offer is no longer open.

acceptDialog.title: Take on the case
acceptDialog.description: You are taking on «{property}» as {role}. The parties to the case will see the registration details you declare, marked as «declared».

verdicts.offered: Press “I take it on” to see the case.
verdicts.unreadable-expiry: Your access cannot be verified — please contact whoever appointed you.
verdicts.scope-missing: Your engagement does not cover viewing the case.
verdicts.not-engaged: You are not part of this case.

case.readOnly: View — you see only the documents of your role.
case.loadError: The case could not be loaded.

activity.title: Trail
activity.loadError: The trail could not be loaded.

files.unavailable: The file is not available right now. Please try again.
